From compact home UPS units to industrial-grade generators, Best Computer Hub stocks a wide range of Power Backup Solutions suited to all types of environments in Bangladesh.

Battery Considerations in Power Backup Solutions

Regardless of whether you’re using a UPS or inverter, the battery plays a critical role. Here are the main types of batteries found in Power Backup Solutions:

🔹 Lead-Acid Batteries

  • Cost-effective
  • Require regular maintenance
  • Shorter lifespan

🔹 Tubular Batteries

  • Higher capacity and longer life
  • Better for inverters
  • More durable

🔹 Lithium-ion Batteries

  • Lightweight and compact
  • Longer lifespan
  • More expensive, found in advanced UPS models

At Best Computer Hub, you can buy complete Power Backup Solutions including batteries, chargers, and monitoring systems.

Tips for Maintaining Your Power Backup System

Regular maintenance is vital to ensure longevity and reliability. Here’s how to keep your Power Backup Solutions in top shape:

  • 🔌 Test UPS and inverter regularly
  • 🔋 Keep batteries charged and replace them every few years
  • 🛢️ For generators, perform oil changes and check fuel levels
  • 🧹 Keep all units dust-free and well-ventilated
  • 🔧 Consult a technician annually for inspection

Best Computer Hub also offers maintenance contracts and battery replacement services to keep your setup running smoothly.

Final Thoughts: Choosing the Best Power Backup Solution

When it comes to keeping your home, office, or business running during power cuts, having the right backup system is essential. Whether it’s the immediacy of a UPS, the extended coverage of an inverter, or the robustness of a generator, each solution has its own strengths and ideal use cases.

What Are Neckband Earphones?

Before diving into the latest features in neckband earphones, let’s understand what they are. Neckband earphones are Bluetooth wireless earphones that rest comfortably around your neck with earbuds connected via short cables. This design combines portability with stability, making them a favorite for active users and professionals.

Why Choose Neckbands Over True Wireless Earbuds?

  • Secure fit, ideal for movement

Whether you’re a student attending online classes, a professional hopping between meetings, or a fitness enthusiast on a morning jog, the latest features in neckband earphones are designed to make your life easier and your audio experience smoother.

1. Active Noise Cancellation (ANC)

One of the latest features in neckband earphones that has truly elevated user experience is Active Noise Cancellation. ANC uses built-in microphones to detect external sounds and cancel them by generating inverse sound waves, giving you a much more immersive listening experience.

Benefits of ANC in Neckbands:

  • Blocks out ambient noise during travel or commute
  • Enhances music clarity
  • Improves call quality in noisy environments
  • Reduces listening fatigue

2. Dual Microphone Setup for Clearer Calls

The shift to remote work and online communication has made call quality more important than ever. The latest features in neckband earphones now include dual-microphone systems that isolate your voice from background noise, making conversations crisp and natural.

3. Long Battery Life & Fast Charging

Another reason neckbands remain popular is their outstanding battery performance. The latest features in neckband earphones now include 20+ hours of playback on a single charge and fast-charging capabilities that provide hours of usage in just a few minutes.

  • Battery indicators via companion apps or LED lights

Magnetic earbuds are no longer just for convenience; they’re smarter now. One of the latest features in neckband earphones includes auto pause and play, where the earphones pause playback when the earbuds are magnetically clipped together and resume when separated.

Benefits:

  • Saves battery life
  • Prevents accidental playback
  • Adds a premium touch to user experience

This feature is especially handy during calls or when you need to quickly remove the earphones without fumbling for your phone.

title: Step-by-Step Guide: Building a Custom PC in Bangladesh
content:
Building your own PC is one of the most rewarding experiences for tech enthusiasts, gamers, professionals, and students alike. Whether you're aiming for a high-performance gaming rig or a reliable workstation for editing, development, or studying, this Step-by-Step Guide will walk you through everything you need to know about assembling a custom PC—specifically in the context of Bangladesh’s tech market.

With the right knowledge, quality parts, and expert support from Best Computer Hub, anyone can build a powerful, cost-effective machine tailored to their needs. Let’s dive into the Step-by-Step Guide to building your dream PC in Bangladesh.

  • Why Build Your Own PC?
  • Step-by-Step Guide to Building a Custom PC in Bangladesh
    • Step 1: Define Your Purpose and Budget
    • Step 2: Choose the Right Components
      • 1. CPU (Processor)
      • 2. Motherboard
      • 3. RAM (Memory)
      • 4. Graphics Card (GPU)

      • 6. Power Supply (PSU)

      • A. Install the CPU
      • B. Install CPU Cooler
      • C. Insert RAM Sticks
      • D. Mount Motherboard
      • E. Install PSU

      • G. Install GPU
      • H. Connect All Cables
      • I. Cable Management
    • Step 5: Power Up and Install OS
  • Where to Buy Genuine PC Components in Bangladesh?
  • Tips for First-Time PC Builders
  • Final Thoughts

Why Build Your Own PC?

Before we begin the Step-by-Step Guide, let’s explore why more people in Bangladesh are choosing to build custom PCs instead of buying prebuilt systems.

  • Cost-Efficiency: Custom PCs often provide better performance per taka than branded prebuilt systems.
  • Customization: You choose what matters—CPU speed, graphics performance, RGB aesthetics, or silent cooling.
  • Upgrade Flexibility: Easily upgrade components over time without replacing the whole system.
  • Hands-On Learning: Gain a deep understanding of how PCs work, which helps in troubleshooting and future builds.

For the best deals and genuine components, many PC builders in Bangladesh turn to Best Computer Hub, a trusted name for quality and customer service.

Step-by-Step Guide to Building a Custom PC in Bangladesh

Step 1: Define Your Purpose and Budget

The first step in this Step-by-Step Guide is identifying what you want the PC to do.

  • Gaming: Requires a strong GPU, fast CPU, and good airflow.
  • Office or Home Use: Mid-range CPU, integrated graphics, and SSD for quick boot times.
  • Content Creation: High core-count CPUs, lots of RAM, fast storage, and capable GPU.
  • Programming/Development: Focus on CPU and RAM, possibly virtualization features.

Once your purpose is clear, set a realistic budget in Bangladeshi Taka. Consider future-proofing by slightly stretching your budget for key components.

Step 2: Choose the Right Components

The heart of any Step-by-Step Guide to building a PC lies in choosing the right hardware. Here’s what you’ll need:

1. CPU (Processor)

Choose between AMD and Intel. For gaming, AMD Ryzen 5 or Intel Core i5 is a sweet spot. For heavy multitasking or video editing, Ryzen 7 or Intel i7 works best.

2. Motherboard

Make sure the motherboard supports your chosen CPU socket and has enough expansion slots, RAM capacity, and ports. For example:

  • Intel 13th Gen → LGA 1700 socket
  • AMD Ryzen 7000 → AM5 socket

Best Computer Hub stocks a wide variety of motherboards from ASUS, Gigabyte, MSI, and ASRock.

3. RAM (Memory)

For gaming or general tasks, 16GB DDR4/DDR5 is enough. For rendering or multitasking, go for 32GB or more.

4. Graphics Card (GPU)

A critical part for gamers and designers. NVIDIA RTX or AMD Radeon series cards offer solid performance. Match it with your monitor's resolution and refresh rate.

5. Storage (SSD/HDD)

NVMe SSDs provide lightning-fast boot and load times. Use a 500GB–1TB SSD for OS and apps, plus a secondary 1TB+ HDD for storage.

6. Power Supply (PSU)

Don’t skimp here. Choose a PSU from a reputable brand with at least 80+ Bronze certification. Calculate your power requirements using online PSU calculators.

7. PC Case

Aesthetic and functional. Make sure it fits your motherboard size (ATX, Micro-ATX), has good airflow, and enough space for future upgrades.

8. Cooling System

Stock coolers work for most builds, but aftermarket air or liquid coolers offer better thermal control and less noise.

All these components are available with warranty and competitive prices at Best Computer Hub, a one-stop destination for PC builders in Bangladesh.

Step 3: Gather Your Tools

In this Step-by-Step Guide, don’t overlook the tools you’ll need:

  • Philips head screwdriver
  • Thermal paste (if not pre-applied)
  • Anti-static wrist strap (optional but recommended)
  • Zip ties or Velcro straps for cable management

Step 4: Assemble the Components

Here’s the part most people get excited about in this Step-by-Step Guide—the actual assembly!

A. Install the CPU

Carefully lift the socket lever, align the CPU (match the triangle), and gently lower it into place. Don’t apply force.

B. Install CPU Cooler

If using a stock cooler, align and secure it with the included bracket. Apply thermal paste if needed.

C. Insert RAM Sticks

Open the latches on the DIMM slots. Firmly press the RAM into place until it clicks.

D. Mount Motherboard

Secure the I/O shield first. Then, place the motherboard on the standoffs in the case and screw it in.

E. Install PSU

Insert the PSU into its designated area, usually at the bottom or top rear. Route the cables through the case’s back panel.

F. Install Storage Devices

Mount SSDs or HDDs in drive bays or M.2 slots. Connect them to the motherboard and PSU.

G. Install GPU

Insert the GPU into the PCIe slot and secure it to the case with screws. Connect PCIe power cables from PSU if needed.

H. Connect All Cables

Connect front panel cables (power, USB, audio), fan headers, SATA cables, and 24-pin and 8-pin power connectors.

I. Cable Management

Use zip ties to bundle excess cables and keep airflow paths clear. A tidy build is a cool build.

Step 5: Power Up and Install OS

Once you’ve double-checked all connections, it’s time to power on your PC. Connect it to a monitor, keyboard, and mouse.

  • Enter BIOS (Del or F2 key)
  • Check hardware is detected
  • Boot from USB with Windows installer
  • Format and install Windows
  • Install drivers from manufacturer’s website

Your custom PC is now ready! This Step-by-Step Guide has taken you from planning to powering on.

Where to Buy Genuine PC Components in Bangladesh?

This Step-by-Step Guide wouldn’t be complete without recommending a reliable vendor. Best Computer Hub is one of the most trusted names in Bangladesh’s tech market, offering:

  • ✅ Genuine and sealed PC parts
  • ✅ All-in-one PC building consultation
  • ✅ Fair pricing and product warranties
  • ✅ Nationwide delivery and support
  • ✅ On-demand custom PC build service

Whether you’re a DIY builder or want professionals to assemble your rig, Best Computer Hub is your ideal partner.

Tips for First-Time PC Builders

To close this Step-by-Step Guide, here are some bonus tips:

  • Start Simple: Don’t go overboard on RGB or liquid cooling if it’s your first build.
  • Watch Tutorials: YouTube is full of visual guides for component installation.
  • Double-Check Compatibility: Use PCPartPicker or consult Best Computer Hub before buying.
  • Test Before Sealing the Case: Always do a boot test before finalizing cable management.
  • Keep Manuals Handy: Component manuals often contain helpful instructions.

Final Thoughts

Building your own computer may seem intimidating at first, but with a clear Step-by-Step Guide, the right parts, and a little patience, it’s a deeply satisfying project. You not only get a custom system tuned to your exact needs but also gain the confidence to upgrade and troubleshoot in the future.

As Bangladesh’s demand for powerful, flexible, and cost-efficient computing grows, more people are turning to custom PC builds. Let this Step-by-Step Guide serve as your blueprint for success—and remember that Best Computer Hub is always here to help with expert advice, quality components, and full-service builds.

Ready to build your PC? Follow this Step-by-Step Guide, gear up with the best hardware from Best Computer Hub, and create a custom machine that works just as hard as you do.

title: How to Choose the Perfect Air Cooler for Your Home or Office
content:
In a world of increasing temperatures and rising energy costs, finding an effective, energy-efficient cooling solution has never been more important. Whether you’re managing a busy office, working from your home workspace, or simply seeking comfort in your living room, choosing the Perfect Air Cooler for Your Home or Office can significantly improve your quality of life. But with so many models, features, and brands on the market, how do you make the right choice?

At Best Computer Hub, we understand how vital it is to have a reliable air cooling solution that suits your environment, lifestyle, and budget. That’s why we've created this comprehensive guide to help you find the Perfect Air Cooler for Your Home or Office in 2025.

  • Why Air Coolers Are a Smart Choice
  • 1. Assess the Size of Your Room or Workspace
  • 2. Choose the Right Type of Air Cooler
  • 3. Evaluate Tank Capacity for Longer Cooling
  • 4. Check for Efficient Cooling Pads
  • 5. Air Delivery and Fan Types
  • 6. Power Consumption and Inverter Compatibility
  • 7. Portability and Design Aesthetics
  • 8. Smart Features for Modern Users
  • 9. Maintenance and Service Support
  • 10. Budget and Brand Trust
  • Final Thoughts: Find the Perfect Air Cooler with Best Computer Hub

Why Air Coolers Are a Smart Choice

Before diving into how to choose the Perfect Air Cooler for Your Home or Office, it’s important to understand why air coolers are a preferred choice for many homeowners and businesses.

Key Benefits of Air Coolers:

  • Energy-efficient: Consumes 75–80% less electricity than an air conditioner
  • Eco-friendly: Uses natural air cooling and no harmful refrigerants
  • Cost-effective: Affordable to purchase and maintain
  • Easy to install and portable: No complex installation, often mobile

Because of these benefits, more and more people are opting for air coolers, especially when seeking the Perfect Air Cooler for Your Home or Office.

1. Assess the Size of Your Room or Workspace

The very first step in choosing the Perfect Air Cooler for Your Home or Office is evaluating the size of the area you want to cool. A small personal cooler won’t be sufficient for a large open-plan office, and an industrial-sized cooler will be overkill for a bedroom.

Here’s a quick size guide:

  • Small rooms (up to 150 sq. ft): Personal coolers (10–20L tank)
  • Medium rooms (150–300 sq. ft): Tower or room coolers (20–40L tank)
  • Large rooms (300+ sq. ft): Desert coolers (40L+ tank capacity)

At Best Computer Hub, we provide expert recommendations based on your room dimensions to ensure you get the Perfect Air Cooler for Your Home or Office.

2. Choose the Right Type of Air Cooler

There are several types of air coolers, each designed for specific environments. Choosing the right type is key to getting the Perfect Air Cooler for Your Home or Office.

Types of Air Coolers:

  • Personal Coolers: Ideal for bedrooms, study rooms, or single-person workstations. These are compact, energy-efficient, and easy to move.
  • Tower Coolers: Tall and slim, perfect for mid-sized areas like living rooms and conference rooms. Offers a good balance of power and space-saving design.
  • Desert Coolers: Designed for large spaces, desert coolers are robust and powerful. They are excellent for open halls, offices, or homes in dry regions.
  • Window Coolers: Installed in a window frame, these save floor space and are ideal for fixed locations.

At Best Computer Hub, we offer all types of air coolers so you can easily find the Perfect Air Cooler for Your Home or Office, no matter the setting.

3. Evaluate Tank Capacity for Longer Cooling

The tank capacity determines how long the cooler can run without needing a refill. For uninterrupted cooling throughout your workday or night’s sleep, selecting the right tank size is crucial.

Suggested Tank Capacities:

  • Up to 20L: Suitable for 3–4 hours of usage – ideal for short-term use
  • 20L–40L: Runs for 6–8 hours, perfect for work-from-home users
  • Above 40L: Ideal for full-day use in offices or large rooms

Choosing the Perfect Air Cooler for Your Home or Office involves ensuring it meets your cooling duration expectations. Best Computer Hub helps you match tank size with your routine.

4. Check for Efficient Cooling Pads

Cooling pads are one of the most important components that affect the performance of any air cooler. When you're searching for the Perfect Air Cooler for Your Home or Office, make sure to consider the type of pads it uses.

Types of Cooling Pads:

  • Honeycomb Pads: Durable, low maintenance, and more effective cooling
  • Aspen/Wood Wool Pads: Budget-friendly but require regular replacement

For long-term value and efficiency, Best Computer Hub recommends air coolers equipped with honeycomb cooling pads—essential for the Perfect Air Cooler for Your Home or Office.

5. Air Delivery and Fan Types

Air delivery is measured in CFM (Cubic Feet per Minute), which indicates how much air the cooler can move. For the Perfect Air Cooler for Your Home or Office, ensure the CFM is appropriate for your room size.

Also, pay attention to the type of fan:

  • Blower Fans: High-pressure airflow, ideal for smaller, focused cooling
  • Axial Fans: Wide area coverage, quieter operation

When choosing the Perfect Air Cooler for Your Home or Office, look for adjustable fan speeds, swing modes, and auto-fill options. At Best Computer Hub, we stock models that combine high-performance airflow with quiet operation.

6. Power Consumption and Inverter Compatibility

Energy savings should never be overlooked. The Perfect Air Cooler for Your Home or Office must be energy-efficient, especially if it's going to be used for long hours.

  • Choose coolers with low wattage (100–200W)
  • Look for inverter-compatible models to use during power outages
  • Check for energy-saving features like auto shut-off or eco mode

With increasing energy costs in 2025, Best Computer Hub emphasizes choosing energy-efficient models that support sustainable usage.

7. Portability and Design Aesthetics

The Perfect Air Cooler for Your Home or Office should be both functional and stylish. A bulky design might ruin the look of your space, while a sleek, modern cooler can complement your interior.

Features to consider:

  • Caster wheels for mobility
  • Compact footprint for small rooms
  • Stylish designs with LED panels or digital controls

8. Smart Features for Modern Users

Modern air coolers come equipped with smart technologies that enhance convenience. For 2025 and beyond, the Perfect Air Cooler for Your Home or Office should include features like:

  • Digital thermostat
  • Timer functions
  • Wi-Fi or app-based controls

9. Maintenance and Service Support

Even the best air cooler requires maintenance. When selecting the Perfect Air Cooler for Your Home or Office, consider how easy it is to clean and whether spare parts are readily available.

What to look for:

  • Detachable water tank for easy cleaning
  • Replaceable filters and pads
  • Service center accessibility
  • Warranty coverage

Best Computer Hub only stocks brands that provide dependable after-sales service and warranty support, making it easier for you to own and maintain the Perfect Air Cooler for Your Home or Office.

10. Budget and Brand Trust

Budget plays a crucial role in your decision-making process. Fortunately, with today’s technology, you don’t need to spend a fortune to get the Perfect Air Cooler for Your Home or Office. Whether you're looking for a premium model or an affordable entry-level cooler, there's something for everyone.

Best Computer Hub works closely with top-tier brands to bring you air coolers that balance price, performance, and reliability. We stock trusted names like Symphony, Bajaj, Orient, Crompton, and more.

Final Thoughts: Find the Perfect Air Cooler with Best Computer Hub

Choosing the Perfect Air Cooler for Your Home or Office doesn’t have to be complicated. With the right guidance and a clear understanding of your needs, you can enjoy cool, clean, and comfortable air without stress.

To recap, when selecting the Perfect Air Cooler for Your Home or Office, remember to:

  • Match the cooler type and size to your space
  • Consider tank capacity and airflow performance
  • Opt for high-efficiency cooling pads and smart features
  • Choose energy-efficient and low-maintenance models
  • Shop from reliable sources like Best Computer Hub

At Best Computer , we’re committed to helping you stay cool all year round with the most advanced, affordable, and stylish air coolers on the market. Whether you're shopping for a single room, a full office, or something in between, you can count on us to deliver the Perfect Air Cooler for Your Home or Office.

During this era, AMD re-entered the performance race with Ryzen 1000 to 3000 series. These CPUs featured more cores and threads at competitive prices.

  • Intel 7th–9th Gen: Strong single-core performance made them ideal for gaming. However, they lagged behind in multi-threaded tasks.

2. Ryzen 5000 Series vs Intel 10th–11th Gen (2020–2021)

With the release of Ryzen 7000 (Zen 4) and Intel’s hybrid Alder and Raptor Lake architecture, the AMD vs Intel Processors race entered a new dimension.

  • Intel 12th–13th Gen: Introduced hybrid architecture with Performance and Efficiency cores. Great for gamers and content creators alike.
  • AMD Ryzen 7000 Series: Based on 5nm technology, delivering strong all-core and single-core speeds, plus support for DDR5 and PCIe 5.0.

In this generation, both brands offered excellent performance, but Intel often had a slight edge in raw gaming benchmarks, while AMD retained better efficiency and platform longevity.

If you're shopping for current-gen processors at Best Computer Hub, this round of AMD vs Intel Processors offers powerful options for gamers and professionals alike.

4. Latest: Ryzen 9000 Series vs Intel 14th Gen (2024–2025)

  • AMD Ryzen 9000 Series (Zen 5): Built on a refined 4nm process with improved AI performance and power efficiency. Ideal for creators and professionals.

Let’s talk budget—because performance is only part of the story. When comparing AMD vs Intel Processors, value for money plays a huge role.

  • Entry-Level: AMD Ryzen 3 and Intel Core i3 CPUs both offer decent power for basic tasks. AMD often wins in core count.

Understanding UPS Basics

Before we dig into price trends and model specifications, let’s understand what a UPS does and what types are available.

What is a UPS?
A UPS (Uninterruptible Power Supply) is a device that supplies emergency power when the main power source fails. It ensures that connected equipment continues running without interruption.

Types of UPS

  1. Offline/Standby UPS
    Simple and budget-friendly. Suitable for basic desktops and small devices.
  2. Line Interactive UPS
    Offers better voltage regulation — ideal for home offices and small businesses.
  3. Online/Double Conversion UPS
    Provides the highest protection and is recommended for servers, data centers, and high-end computers.

Knowing the type helps when assessing UPS Price Bangladesh and choosing the Best UPS for your needs.
